candidates.title: RazorAttention: Efficient KV Cache Compression Through Retrieval Heads
candidates.reason: Retrieval-head-aware KV-cache compression method designed to reduce long-context inference memory while preserving critical retrieval behavior.

candidates.title: AdapMoE: Adaptive Sensitivity-based Expert Gating and Management for Efficient MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Algorithm-system co-design for edge MoE inference combining adaptive expert activation, prefetching, and cache management to reduce loading overhead.

candidates.title: Fast Inference for Augmented Large Language Models
candidates.reason: LAMPS is a vLLM-based scheduler for augmented LLM requests with API gaps, jointly optimizing KV-memory handling and request scheduling.

candidates.title: DynamicKV: Task-Aware Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Long Context LLMs
candidates.reason: Task-aware adaptive KV-cache compression that varies retention according to workload/context characteristics rather than using one static policy.

candidates.title: eMoE: Task-aware Memory Efficient Mixture-of-Experts-Based (MoE) Model Inference
candidates.reason: Memory-efficient MoE serving system using expert prediction/loading and task-aware SLO scheduling, reporting major memory and throughput gains.
